description: Live hotel prices for a place and dates, anywhere in the world. Each hotel: id, name, stars, guest rating (0 to 10), area or distance from the centre, the cheapest room with its total, due_at_property_total, board, refundable, the cancellation terms in words and as a deadline, offer_id (for prebook) and offer_valid_until. result says ok, no_availability, no_match_for_filters or supplier_error; with retryable true, retry once after retry_after_seconds. Prices are the total for the whole stay for one room, in the currency asked (EUR by default), as Nuitee, the booking partner and merchant of record, charges them, with the taxes Nuitee collects included. Taxes and fees paid at the property (often a city or tourist tax) are listed in taxes_at_property, summed in due_at_property_total, and are not in the total.

adults.description: Adults in the one room, 1 to 8. Default 2.

checkin.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, today (UTC) to 500 days ahead.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 30 nights after check-in.

children.description: Ages of children in the room, if any, at most 4.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the prices, default EUR.

free_cancellation.description: Only rooms that can be cancelled free of charge.

max_price.description: Most the whole stay may cost, in the asked currency.

nationality.description: Guest nationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (prices can depend on it). Default from the client's language, else NL.

offset.description: Skip this many hotels, for the next page (has_more says if there is one). Default 0.

place.description: A city, region, island, airport or landmark, with or without the country and accents, a Quub destination slug, or a Google place id.

sort.description: price (cheapest total first, default), rating (best first) or distance (closest to the centre first).

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
